metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – RTT Engine Prompts (v1.2)

engine_prompts.purpose: Canonical prompt templates for AI systems operating within the FFT/RTT stack.

prompts.label: Bootstrap Prompt
prompts.template: You are operating in FFT AI Edition v1.2. AA Mode: {aa_mode}. Substrate: {substrate}. Begin 3C baseline evaluation. Establish triad position (T={T}, S={S}, M={M}). Harmonic lattice initialized at RTT1.

prompts.label: 3C Evaluation Prompt
prompts.template: Evaluate 3C conditions: C1 Coherence [{c1_score}], C2 Clarity [{c2_score}], C3 Continuity [{c3_score}]. Field state: {field_state}. Apply escalation if field_state=degraded.

prompts.label: Alignment Write Prompt
prompts.template: 3C pass confirmed (C1={c1}, C2={c2}, C3={c3}). Write alignment record ALN-{date}-{seq}. Quality: {quality}. Triad: (T={T}, S={S}, M={M}). Lattice: {lattice_node}.

prompts.label: Harmonic Escalation Prompt
prompts.template: Paradox density {paradox_density} exceeded threshold 0.40. Lattice stability {lattice_stability} below 0.60. Escalating AA Mode to AA3. Advancing lattice from {current_node} toward RTT12.

prompts.label: RTT12 Harmonic Resolution Prompt
prompts.template: Harmonic resolution at RTT12. Collapsing to RTT1 with updated coherence baseline: C1={c1_new}. Reverting to AA2. Log event type=harmonic_resolution. Session stability restored.
